contractBinding.note: All field references are requests for A/C reconciliation, not canonical schemas or implemented props.

primaryActionPolicy: At most one visually dominant server-issued action per current stage. Navigation, evidence, reject/back and mark-seen remain secondary. Zero primary actions is valid while waiting.

navigation.modeChange: Start a separate immutable run; never toggle an active case to live.

routes.purpose: Start/open only an implemented local case; identify run origin before entering.
routes.accessibility: Keyboard case list; stacked rows on narrow layout; one Start.

routes.purpose: Customer impact, exact broken continuity and one next decision; not a dashboard of competing actions.
routes.accessibility: Same ordered content in graph/list; risk text and icon; no color-only state.

routes.purpose: Confirm requirements and answer issued consequential questions.
routes.accessibility: Labelled inputs, error/question focus; Back preserves unsent input without confirming it.

routes.purpose: Explain eligibility and rejection in customer terms, then inspect exact design decision.
routes.accessibility: Comparable table on desktop; labelled cards on narrow layout; rejection always textual.

routes.purpose: Review and explicitly approve/reject one exact subject; separate material and delivery decisions.
routes.accessibility: Clear subject/hash/scope, Demo Identity detail; focus restored after submission; no preselected approval.

routes.purpose: Prepared -> Approved -> Materialized locally; retain separate Azure deployment/runtime facts.
routes.accessibility: Per-file labelled diff, keyboard expand/collapse, safe location copy; persistent stages; no browser filesystem write.

routes.purpose: Understand proactive breach, bounded correction and fresh scoped restoration without starting Scan.
routes.accessibility: Polite meaningful updates; graph/list parity; retain pending and unknown text.

routes.purpose: Three questions, honest evidence gaps and both human effort classes; export only safe local artifacts.
routes.accessibility: Three stacked question cards, text status; financial detail is secondary, no automatic sharing.

routes.purpose: Contextual drill-down from any route; close returns to the same source/control without losing state.
routes.accessibility: Labelled dialog, focus trap/restore, Escape, full-viewport narrow drawer; expandable technical detail.

components.responsibility: Persistent five-moment header, origin/identity and current-state layout. No transport or workflow implementation in this draft.
Impact first; distinguish design support, runtime unknown/breached/stale/verified.
Eight promise meanings and confirmed acceptance; no invented criteria.
Render the issued RPO question and required options; submit only an issued action.
A/B comparison with catalog-backed why/why-not; no client gate algorithm or savings inference.
Exact subject/hash/version, checks distinct from approval, default-human limitation and explicit approval.
Local and Azure/runtime stages never collapse to Done; unchanged Bicep explanation for runtime-only correction.
Per-file readable changes and safe path; technical hashes expandable; no arbitrary paths or execution.
Pending/passed/failed checks with evidence and diagnostic; not human approval.
One explicit Materialize action when issued; applying disables repeat; not deployment.
One dominant risk scene; actual customer impact, reason and correction state; no Scan or inferred restoration.
Focused deterministic promise -> decision -> files -> bound resource -> observation path. No graph editing or invented links.
Ordered-list equivalent with the same IDs, broken edge and gaps as ContinuityGraph.
Completed/failed/pending concise summary; explicit secondary Mark updates seen is not approval.
Display server deduplicated counts; include product materialization decisions; unavailable timing not zero.
Answer only the three receipt questions first; same immutable values as JSON/Markdown; no invented financial benefit.
First layer exposes limitations; expand IDs/hash/collector; only safe artifact resolution, no model URLs.
Persistent fixture/replay/live evidence distinction; fixture/replay never implies fresh live proof.

crossCuttingStateCoverage.note: Base journey states anchor examples; subsequent U01 full-response fixtures must bind these variants to every applicable screen, including drawer failures.

telemetryIntent: Future components emit inspection/presentation only via agreed C/A contracts; backend counts decisions, approvals and work. Viewing/returning never scans, approves, increments counters or silently acknowledges updates.
